This data set contains the fifteen (15) scans of the Blubber House, Herschel Island. All data was collected by the Capture2Presev Team. The ten (10) exterior scans were collected with the Z+F 5010X on the 10th July, 2018, and processed registered with Z+F Laser Scout and Z+F Laser Control V.8.9.0. The five (5) interior scans were collected with the Leica BLK 360 on the 10th July, 2019, and processed and registered with Autodesk Recap Mobile and Autodesk Recap Pro V.6.1. The exterior and interior scans were registered together with in Autodesk Recap Pro V.6.1.
